episodes.title: 开学第一天
episodes.desc: 怎么开口、怎么接话，交到第一个新朋友

lines.en: Uh, hey — is this seat taken?
lines.zh: 呃，你好——这个座位有人吗？

lines.en: Nope, go ahead! You're new here, right? I haven't seen you before.
lines.zh: 没有，坐吧！你是新来的吧？我之前没见过你。

lines.en: Yeah, today's my first day. Honestly, I almost got lost twice this morning.
lines.zh: 对，今天是我第一天。说实话，今天早上我差点迷路两次。

lines.en: Welcome to Walk and Talk, the podcast you can listen to while you walk. I'm Jenny.
lines.zh: 欢迎收听 Walk and Talk，一个边散步边听的播客。我是 Jenny。

lines.en: Today, we start with something everyone knows — the first day at a new school. New faces, new hallways, and one big question: how do you make friends?
lines.zh: 今天，我们从一个大家都经历过的事说起——新学校的第一天。新面孔、新走廊，还有一个大问题：怎么交到朋友？

lines.en: I'm Jake. My family just moved here last week.
lines.zh: 我叫 Jake。我们全家上周刚搬过来。

lines.en: Cool, I'm Mia. Welcome to Sunshine Middle School. How do you like it so far?
lines.zh: 酷，我是 Mia。欢迎来到阳光中学。到目前为止感觉怎么样？

lines.en: It's... big? The campus is twice as big as my old one.
lines.zh: 就是……挺大的？校园比我以前的学校大两倍。

lines.en: Ha, wait till you see the sports field. So where are you from?
lines.zh: 哈，等你看到操场再说。你从哪儿来？

lines.en: A small town called Greenfield. Nothing exciting there, I promise.
lines.zh: 一个叫绿野镇的小地方。真的没什么好玩的，我保证。

lines.en: Small towns are cool. My grandma lives in one — everyone knows everyone.
lines.zh: 小镇挺好的。我奶奶就住在那种地方——所有人都认识所有人。

lines.en: Exactly! That's the thing I miss already.
lines.zh: 就是这个！我已经开始想念这一点了。

lines.en: Don't worry, you'll like it here. What grade are you in?
lines.zh: 别担心，你会喜欢上这里的。你几年级？

lines.en: Eighth. You?
lines.zh: 八年级。你呢？

lines.en: Same! We're probably in the same class then. What's your favorite subject?
lines.zh: 一样！那我们可能同班。你最喜欢什么科目？

lines.en: Science, I guess. I like doing experiments.
lines.zh: 科学吧。我喜欢做实验。

lines.en: Nice, Mr. Lee's class is awesome. He lets us do real experiments — like, with fire sometimes.
lines.zh: 不错，李老师的课超棒。他让我们做真正的实验——有时候还用火。

lines.en: Whoa, now I'm actually excited.
lines.zh: 哇，这下我真有点兴奋了。

lines.en: Hey, we eat lunch at twelve. Want to sit with us? Me and my friends.
lines.zh: 嘿，我们十二点吃午饭。要不要跟我们坐？我和我的朋友们。

lines.en: Really? That'd be great. Thanks!
lines.zh: 真的吗？那太好了。谢谢！

lines.en: See? Making friends is not that hard. Jake asked one simple question, and Mia did the rest.
lines.zh: 看吧？交朋友没那么难。Jake 问了一个简单的问题，剩下的 Mia 都接住了。

lines.en: Over here, Jake! This is Leo, and that's Emma.
lines.zh: 这边，Jake！这是 Leo，那是 Emma。

lines.en: Hey, new guy. I'm Leo. Cool backpack.
lines.zh: 嘿，新同学。我是 Leo。书包不错。

lines.en: Thanks. It's got all my science stuff in it.
lines.zh: 谢谢。里面装的全是科学课的东西。

lines.en: You like science? Emma's crazy about it, too.
lines.zh: 你喜欢科学？Emma 对科学也超狂热。

lines.en: Guys, come on. Jake, don't listen to him. So — do you play any sports?
lines.zh: 你们俩，行了。Jake，别听他的。那——你运动吗？

lines.en: Basketball, mostly. I'm not great, but I enjoy it.
lines.zh: 主要是篮球。打得不算好，但我喜欢。

lines.en: Perfect. We play every Friday after school. You should come.
lines.zh: 完美。我们每周五放学后都打。你应该来。

lines.en: Deal! Oh no, is that the bell? We just sat down!
lines.zh: 成交！哦不，是上课铃吗？我们才刚坐下啊！

lines.en: Yeah, lunch is only thirty minutes. Come on, I'll show you where the science room is.
lines.zh: 是啊，午饭只有三十分钟。走吧，我带你去找科学教室。

lines.en: You're the best, Mia. Seriously.
lines.zh: 你太好了，Mia。真的。

lines.en: Before we slow things down, here are some useful phrases from today's conversations.
lines.zh: 在我们放慢速度之前，来听几个今天对话里有用的表达。

lines.en: Is this seat taken?
lines.zh: 这个座位有人吗？

lines.en: How do you like it so far?
lines.zh: 你目前感觉怎么样？

lines.en: Wait till you see the sports field.
lines.zh: 等你看到操场就知道了。

lines.en: Want to sit with us?
lines.zh: 要不要跟我们一起坐？

lines.en: Is this seat taken?
lines.zh: 这个座位有人吗？

lines.en: I haven't seen you before.
lines.zh: 我以前没见过你。

lines.en: How do you like it so far?
lines.zh: 到目前为止你觉得怎么样？

lines.en: Wait till you...
lines.zh: 等你……就知道了

lines.en: What's your favorite subject?
lines.zh: 你最喜欢的科目是什么？

lines.en: You should come.
lines.zh: 你应该来（发出邀请）。

lines.en: That'd be great.
lines.zh: 那太好了。

lines.en: You're the best.
lines.zh: 你人真好（口语感谢）。

lines.en: Your turn: tonight, introduce yourself out loud in English for thirty seconds — your name, where you're from, and one thing you love.
lines.zh: 轮到你了：今晚用英语大声做三十秒自我介绍——你的名字、你来自哪里，还有一件你喜欢的事。

lines.en: That's it for today. Next time, we talk about mornings — and what happens when your alarm clock betrays you. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 今天就到这里。下一集我们聊聊早晨——以及当你的闹钟背叛你时会发生什么。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 起床大作战
episodes.desc: 闹钟没响、车胎没气——一个手忙脚乱的早晨

lines.en: Mia! You will not believe what happened this morning.
lines.zh: Mia！你绝对不敢相信今天早上发生了什么。

lines.en: Let me guess. You overslept again?
lines.zh: 我猜猜。你又睡过头了？

lines.en: Worse. My alarm didn't go off, and I woke up at seven forty!
lines.zh: 更糟。我闹钟没响，我七点四十才醒！

lines.en: Mornings. Some people love them. Most of us just survive them.
lines.zh: 早晨。有人热爱早晨，我们大多数人只是勉强撑过去。

lines.en: Today, we follow Jake through one of those mornings where everything — and I mean everything — goes wrong.
lines.zh: 今天，我们跟着 Jake 度过一个所有事情——真的是所有事情——都出岔子的早晨。

lines.en: So I jumped out of bed, brushed my teeth in one minute, and ran out the door.
lines.zh: 于是我跳下床，一分钟刷完牙，冲出了家门。

lines.en: Did you eat anything?
lines.zh: 你吃东西了吗？

lines.en: I grabbed a piece of bread. Well... half of a piece.
lines.zh: 我抓了一片面包。呃……半片。

lines.en: That's not breakfast, that's a joke.
lines.zh: 那不是早餐，那是个笑话。

lines.en: Tell me about it. And then — my bike had a flat tire!
lines.zh: 可不是嘛。然后——我自行车胎没气了！

lines.en: No way. So how did you get here?
lines.zh: 不会吧。那你怎么到学校的？

lines.en: I ran. Three kilometers. In my school shoes.
lines.zh: 我跑来的。三公里。穿着我的校鞋。

lines.en: And you're not even sweaty?
lines.zh: 你居然都没出汗？

lines.en: I am. Very. Don't stand too close.
lines.zh: 我出了。很多。别站太近。

lines.en: Ha! Okay, okay. But seriously, Jake — why not just set two alarms?
lines.zh: 哈！好好好。不过说真的，Jake——为什么不设两个闹钟？

lines.en: I do set two. The problem is, I turn both off in my sleep. My mom says I could sleep through a fire alarm.
lines.zh: 我确实设了两个。问题是我睡着的时候把它们都关了。我妈说我火警响了都能继续睡。

lines.en: That's a talent, honestly.
lines.zh: 说实话，这是个天赋。

lines.en: A useless talent.
lines.zh: 一个没用的天赋。

lines.en: My dad is the same. Once he slept through my birthday party. A daytime party.
lines.zh: 我爸也一样。有一次他睡过了我的生日派对。白天办的派对。

lines.en: Wait, really? How is that possible?
lines.zh: 等等，真的假的？这怎么可能？

lines.en: He worked night shifts that week. But we still make fun of him for it.
lines.zh: 那周他上夜班。但我们至今还拿这事笑他。

lines.en: Mia's family has a secret for mornings, by the way. Here's what she told Jake.
lines.zh: 顺便说一句，Mia 家对付早晨有个秘诀。听听她跟 Jake 说了什么。

lines.en: Anyway, here's our secret. We prep everything the night before.
lines.zh: 总之，这是我们家的秘诀：前一晚把一切都准备好。

lines.en: Like what?
lines.zh: 比如什么？

lines.en: School bag by the door, clothes on the chair, and my mom puts the bread next to the kettle.
lines.zh: 书包放门口，衣服搭椅子上，我妈把面包放在水壶旁边。

lines.en: That's it? No magic?
lines.zh: 就这样？没有魔法？

lines.en: That's it. Mornings are just ten tiny battles, Jake. Win them the night before.
lines.zh: 就这样。早晨不过是十场小战斗，Jake。前一晚就赢下它们。

lines.en: You sound like a poster in the school hallway.
lines.zh: 你说话像学校走廊里的标语海报。

lines.en: I'll take that as a compliment.
lines.zh: 我就当这是夸奖吧。

lines.en: Before we slow things down, here are the best lines from this morning's disaster.
lines.zh: 在放慢之前，来回顾一下今早这场灾难里的金句。

lines.en: My alarm didn't go off.
lines.zh: 我的闹钟没响。

lines.en: I overslept again.
lines.zh: 我又睡过头了。

lines.en: Tell me about it.
lines.zh: 可不是嘛。

lines.en: I'll take that as a compliment.
lines.zh: 我就当这是夸奖吧。

lines.en: You will not believe what happened.
lines.zh: 你绝对不敢相信发生了什么。

lines.en: My alarm didn't go off.
lines.zh: 我的闹钟没响。

lines.en: I overslept.
lines.zh: 我睡过头了。

lines.en: Tell me about it.
lines.zh: 可不是嘛（表示同感）。

lines.en: No way.
lines.zh: 不会吧。

lines.en: sleep through something
lines.zh: 睡着了没被（警报/噪音）吵醒

lines.en: prep everything the night before
lines.zh: 前一晚把一切都准备好

lines.en: I'll take that as a compliment.
lines.zh: 我就当这是夸奖吧。

lines.en: Tonight before bed, say your morning plan out loud in English: bag by the door, clothes on the chair, breakfast ready. Then win your ten tiny battles.
lines.zh: 今晚睡前，用英语大声说出你的早晨计划：书包放门口、衣服搭椅子上、早餐备好。然后赢下你的十场小战斗。

lines.en: Next time, we're heading to the school cafeteria — where the meatballs are a mystery and the line is very, very long. See you!
lines.zh: 下一集，我们去学校食堂——那里的肉丸是个谜，队伍非常非常长。再见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 食堂风云
episodes.desc: 神秘肉丸、疯狂长队和饭桌上的好段子

lines.en: Dude, what IS that on your tray?
lines.zh: 老兄，你餐盘上那是什么？

lines.en: I have no idea. It's Tuesday, so... meatballs? Maybe?
lines.zh: 我也不知道。今天是周二，所以……肉丸？可能吧？

lines.en: Those are not meatballs. Those are rumors of meatballs.
lines.zh: 那不是肉丸。那是肉丸的传闻。

lines.en: Welcome back to Walk and Talk. Today: lunchtime.
lines.zh: 欢迎回到 Walk and Talk。今天的话题：午餐时间。

lines.en: The school cafeteria — crazy lines, mystery food, and honestly, some of the best conversations of the whole day.
lines.zh: 学校食堂——疯狂的队伍、神秘的饭菜，还有说真的，一天当中最精彩的那些对话。

lines.en: The line is already crazy. We got here four minutes after the bell.
lines.zh: 队伍已经排疯了。铃响四分钟后我们就到了。

lines.en: Four minutes is late, my friend. Four minutes is very late.
lines.zh: 四分钟就是晚了，我的朋友。四分钟非常晚。

lines.en: Look at the menu board. Fish and chips on Monday, noodles on Wednesday...
lines.zh: 看菜单板。周一炸鱼薯条，周三面条……

lines.en: And on Tuesday, the mystery. You never know what you're going to get.
lines.zh: 而周二是谜之菜品。你永远不知道会拿到什么。

lines.en: Okay, decision time. Noodle soup, or the mystery tray?
lines.zh: 好，做决定吧。面汤，还是谜之餐盘？

lines.en: Noodle soup. Always pick the thing you can name.
lines.zh: 面汤。永远选你能叫出名字的东西。

lines.en: Solid advice. One noodle soup, please. And a milk.
lines.zh: 好建议。一份面汤，谢谢。再加一盒牛奶。

lines.en: Make that two. And two buns, please. Thank you.
lines.zh: 来两份。再加两个馒头，谢谢。

lines.en: Where do we sit? Everything's full.
lines.zh: 我们坐哪儿？全满了。

lines.en: There — Mia saved us seats by the window. Come on.
lines.zh: 那儿——Mia 在窗边帮我们占了座。快走。

lines.en: At the table, the food review begins. This is where Jake learns a very important lesson about Tuesday.
lines.zh: 到了饭桌，美食点评开始。Jake 就是在这里学到了关于周二的重要一课。

lines.en: Took you long enough! We've been waiting.
lines.zh: 你们可真够慢的！我们都等半天了。

lines.en: You try fighting that line with empty hands, Mia.
lines.zh: 你空着手去跟那条队伍斗一斗试试，Mia。

lines.en: Fair. So how's the noodle soup today?
lines.zh: 有道理。今天的面汤怎么样？

lines.en: Actually pretty good! Way better than last week, when it was basically hot water with two noodles in it.
lines.zh: 其实还挺好喝！比上周强多了，上周那碗基本就是热水里泡着两根面。

lines.en: I had that one. It was soup-flavored soup.
lines.zh: 我喝过那碗。那是汤味的汤。

lines.en: Ha! You two sound like food critics.
lines.zh: 哈！你俩说话像美食评论家。

lines.en: Speaking of food — Emma, your homemade cookies last Friday? Amazing. Could my mom get the recipe?
lines.zh: 说到吃的——Emma，你上周五带的自制饼干？绝了。我妈能要个配方吗？

lines.en: She doesn't really use a recipe. She just throws things in. That's why they're never the same twice.
lines.zh: 她其实不用配方。就是随便往里扔。所以饼干每次都不一样。

lines.en: Even better. Every cookie is a surprise.
lines.zh: 那更好了。每一块饼干都是惊喜。

lines.en: Hey, look — they have apple pie today. Get it before the eighth graders clean it out.
lines.zh: 嘿，看——今天有苹果派。趁八年级那帮人还没抢光，赶紧买。

lines.en: Too late. Table nine already has four plates of it.
lines.zh: 晚了。九号桌已经有四盘了。

lines.en: Those kids are professionals.
lines.zh: 那帮孩子是专业的。

lines.en: Before we slow down, here are the tastiest lines from today.
lines.zh: 放慢之前，来听今天最有味道的几句。

lines.en: You never know what you're going to get.
lines.zh: 你永远不知道会得到什么。

lines.en: How's the noodle soup today?
lines.zh: 今天面汤怎么样？

lines.en: Speaking of food...
lines.zh: 说到吃的……

lines.en: Too late.
lines.zh: 太晚了（来不及了）。

lines.en: What IS that?
lines.zh: 那到底是什么？

lines.en: I have no idea.
lines.zh: 我完全不知道。

lines.en: Always pick the thing you can name.
lines.zh: 永远选你能叫出名字的东西。

lines.en: Took you long enough!
lines.zh: 你可真够慢的！

lines.en: Speaking of...
lines.zh: 说到……（话题转换）

lines.en: clean out
lines.zh: 一抢而空

lines.en: Those kids are professionals.
lines.zh: 那帮孩子是专业的。

lines.en: soup-flavored soup
lines.zh: 汤味的汤（吐槽没味道）

lines.en: Today's challenge: describe your lunch out loud in English — what it was, how it tasted, and whether you'd order it again.
lines.zh: 今日挑战：用英语大声描述你的午餐——吃了什么、味道如何、还会不会再点。

lines.en: Next time, we leave school and go to a burger shop — where Jake learns the most important question in fast food. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 下一集，我们离开学校去汉堡店——Jake 将在那里学到快餐界最重要的问题。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 汉堡店点餐
episodes.desc: 点餐全程英文实操，公园里还传来一个好消息

lines.en: Hi there! Welcome to Burger Corner. What can I get started for you?
lines.zh: 你好！欢迎来到汉堡角。你想来点什么？

lines.en: Hi! Can I get a cheeseburger meal, please?
lines.zh: 你好！我要一个芝士汉堡套餐，谢谢。

lines.en: Sure. Fries and a drink come with it. Small, medium, or large?
lines.zh: 好的。套餐配薯条和饮料。小杯、中杯还是大杯？

lines.en: Today we're ordering food — burgers, fries, and one very important question: for here, or to go?
lines.zh: 今天我们来点餐——汉堡、薯条，还有一个非常重要的问题：在这儿吃，还是带走？

lines.en: Jake is meeting Mia at the park. But first, he has to survive the lunch rush.
lines.zh: Jake 要去公园见 Mia。但首先，他得先挺过午饭高峰。

lines.en: Sure. Fries and a drink come with it. Small, medium, or large?
lines.zh: 好的。套餐含薯条和饮料。小、中、大杯？

lines.en: Medium, please. And can I swap the cola for orange juice?
lines.zh: 中杯，谢谢。能把可乐换成橙汁吗？

lines.en: No problem. Anything else? Our apple pie is two-for-one today.
lines.zh: 没问题。还要别的吗？今天苹果派买一送一。

lines.en: Tempting... but no, thanks. I'm good.
lines.zh: 好心动……但不用了，谢谢。

lines.en: For here or to go?
lines.zh: 在这儿吃还是带走？

lines.en: To go, please. I'm meeting a friend at the park.
lines.zh: 带走，谢谢。我要去公园见朋友。

lines.en: That'll be six fifty. Card or cash?
lines.zh: 一共六块五。刷卡还是现金？

lines.en: Card, please. Here you go.
lines.zh: 刷卡。给你。

lines.en: Great. Your number is twenty-seven. We'll call you at the pickup window.
lines.zh: 好。你的号码是 27 号。取餐窗口会叫号。

lines.en: Thanks a lot!
lines.zh: 多谢！

lines.en: Enjoy! And hey — extra napkins are by the door. Just saying.
lines.zh: 慢用！对了——门口有多余的纸巾。好心提醒。

lines.en: You're a hero. Thank you.
lines.zh: 你是英雄。谢谢你。

lines.en: Two minutes later, Jake arrives at the park. Mia is already there — with some big news.
lines.zh: 两分钟后，Jake 到了公园。Mia 已经在那儿了——还带着一个大消息。

lines.en: Sorry I'm late — the line was long. I got you a cheeseburger too. Hope that's okay.
lines.zh: 抱歉来晚了——队太长。我也给你买了个芝士汉堡，希望你喜欢。

lines.en: Are you kidding? You're my favorite person today. So. Big news.
lines.zh: 开什么玩笑？你是我今天最喜欢的人。好了。大消息。

lines.en: What happened?
lines.zh: 怎么了？

lines.en: I passed the audition! For the school band. I'm playing the keyboard!
lines.zh: 我通过选拔了！学校乐队的！我弹键盘！

lines.en: No way! Mia, that's awesome! Since when do you play?
lines.zh: 不会吧！Mia，太棒了！你什么时候会弹琴的？

lines.en: Since fourth grade. But I never told anyone — I was too shy.
lines.zh: 四年级就开始了。但我谁也没告诉过——我太害羞了。

lines.en: Well, now everyone's going to know you're great. When's the first show?
lines.zh: 那现在大家都要知道你有多厉害了。第一场演出是什么时候？

lines.en: Next month, at the school festival. I'm kind of terrified, honestly.
lines.zh: 下个月，校园艺术节上。说实话我有点吓坏了。

lines.en: You'll be fine. And I'll be in the front row, being loud.
lines.zh: 你没问题。我会坐在第一排，使劲喝彩。

lines.en: Please don't bring a banner.
lines.zh: 千万别带横幅。

lines.en: No promises.
lines.zh: 我可不敢保证。

lines.en: Before we slow things down, here's how to order like a pro.
lines.zh: 放慢之前，来学学怎么像老手一样点餐。

lines.en: What can I get started for you?
lines.zh: 你想来点什么？

lines.en: For here or to go?
lines.zh: 在这儿吃还是带走？

lines.en: That'll be six fifty.
lines.zh: 一共六块五。

lines.en: I'm good, thanks.
lines.zh: 不用了，谢谢。

lines.en: Can I get ..., please?
lines.zh: 我要一份……（点餐万能句）

lines.en: For here or to go?
lines.zh: 在这儿吃还是带走？

lines.en: Anything else?
lines.zh: 还要别的吗？

lines.en: I'm good, thanks.
lines.zh: 不用了，谢谢。

lines.en: That'll be ...
lines.zh: 一共是……钱。

lines.en: Card or cash?
lines.zh: 刷卡还是现金？

lines.en: No way! That's awesome!
lines.zh: 不会吧！太棒了！

lines.en: No promises.
lines.zh: 我可不敢保证。

lines.en: Next time you order anything — bubble tea, bread, noodles — say the whole order in English in your head: what you want, the size, and for here or to go.
lines.zh: 下次你买任何东西——奶茶、面包、面条——在心里用英语把整个订单说出来：要什么、什么规格、堂食还是带走。

lines.en: Next time: new sneakers. They glow in the dark, they cost too much, and Mia has opinions. See you!
lines.zh: 下一集：新球鞋。会发光，价格离谱，而且 Mia 有一堆意见。再见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 买球鞋
episodes.desc: 发光的鞋 vs 打折的鞋，谁赢了？

lines.en: Mom said I can get new sneakers if I keep my grades up. Look at these — they glow in the dark!
lines.zh: 我妈说只要我保住成绩就能买新球鞋。看这双——它们会在黑暗里发光！

lines.en: They glow? Okay, first of all, that's amazing. Second of all — how much are they?
lines.zh: 会发光？好，首先，这很酷。其次——多少钱？

lines.en: ...Don't ask.
lines.zh: ……别问。

lines.en: Shopping! Today Jake takes Mia sneaker shopping, and Mia teaches him the most powerful word in shopping: budget.
lines.zh: 购物！今天 Jake 拉着 Mia 去买球鞋，而 Mia 教会他购物界最有力的一个词：预算。

lines.en: Whoa, look at these. They glow in the dark, Mia. GLOW.
lines.zh: 哇，看这双。它们会在黑暗里发光，Mia。发光！

lines.en: I see. And the price tag? Three hundred eighty, Jake. That's more than your monthly allowance, isn't it?
lines.zh: 看到了。那价签呢？三百八，Jake。比你一个月零花钱还多，是不是？

lines.en: Let me do the math... yeah. It is exactly more than my monthly allowance.
lines.zh: 我算算……对。恰好比我的月零花钱多。

lines.en: Okay, rule one of shopping: just because it glows doesn't mean you need it.
lines.zh: 好，购物第一条：会发光不代表你需要它。

lines.en: Hi guys! Looking for anything special?
lines.zh: 你们好！想找什么样的？

lines.en: Hi, yeah — running shoes, size forty. Do you have these in blue?
lines.zh: 你好——跑鞋，40 码。这双有蓝色的吗？

lines.en: Let me check the back... I have thirty-nine and forty-one. The forty is nearly sold out, sorry.
lines.zh: 我去后面看看……有 39 和 41 码。40 码快卖完了，抱歉。

lines.en: What about this pair? Same brand, twenty percent off this week.
lines.zh: 那这双呢？同品牌，这周打八折。

lines.en: Good eye. Those are on sale — two hundred forty.
lines.zh: 好眼光。那双在打折——二百四。

lines.en: Hmm. They don't glow, though.
lines.zh: 嗯……可它们不发光啊。

lines.en: But they won't glow-blink at you from the box when your mom checks the receipt.
lines.zh: 但当你妈查小票的时候，它们不会在鞋盒里冲你一闪一闪。

lines.en: ...That's fair. Okay, I'll take them. Can I try them on first?
lines.zh: ……有道理。好，我买了。能先试试吗？

lines.en: Of course. There's the bench. Take your time.
lines.zh: 当然可以。长凳在那边。慢慢试。

lines.en: And here's how it ended — walking out of the store, thirty seconds later.
lines.zh: 结局如何——三十秒后，走出店门。

lines.en: See? You got good shoes AND money left for bubble tea. That's called a win-win.
lines.zh: 看吧？你买到了好鞋，还剩下买奶茶的钱。这就叫双赢。

lines.en: You're scary good at this. How do you know all this stuff?
lines.zh: 你这也太强了。这些都是跟谁学的？

lines.en: My mom taught me. She says: a smart buyer knows three numbers — the price, the budget, and the discount.
lines.zh: 我妈教的。她说：聪明的买家知道三个数字——价格、预算、折扣。

lines.en: Say that again, I'm writing it on my phone.
lines.zh: 再说一遍，我记到手机里。

lines.en: Also — never shop hungry. You buy weird things when you're hungry.
lines.zh: 还有——千万别饿着肚子逛街。饿的时候你会买奇怪的东西。

lines.en: Too late. I almost bought a glowing hat earlier.
lines.zh: 晚了。我刚才差点买了一顶会发光的帽子。

lines.en: Of course you did.
lines.zh: 你果然干了。

lines.en: Before we slow down, here's your shopping survival kit.
lines.zh: 放慢之前，这是你的购物生存包。

lines.en: Do you have these in blue?
lines.zh: 这个有蓝色的吗？

lines.en: Can I try them on?
lines.zh: 我能试穿吗？

lines.en: It's twenty percent off.
lines.zh: 打八折。

lines.en: I'll take it.
lines.zh: 我买了。

lines.en: How much is it?
lines.zh: 多少钱？

lines.en: It's on sale.
lines.zh: 它在打折。

lines.en: twenty percent off
lines.zh: 打八折

lines.en: Can I try it on?
lines.zh: 我能试穿吗？

lines.en: I'll take it.
lines.zh: 我要买它。

lines.en: Just because it glows doesn't mean you need it.
lines.zh: 会发光不代表你需要它。

lines.en: win-win
lines.zh: 双赢

lines.en: Never shop hungry.
lines.zh: 别饿着肚子逛街。

lines.en: Next time you see a price tag, practice this in your head: 'It costs ... yuan, and it's ... percent off.' Numbers are muscles. Train them.
lines.zh: 下次看到价签，在心里练习这句话：“它卖……元，打……折。”数字是肌肉，要练。

lines.en: Next time: rain ruins the weekend... or does it? Mia defends the rainy Saturday. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 下一集：雨毁了周末……真的吗？Mia 要为下雨的周六辩护。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 下雨的周末
episodes.desc: 骑行泡汤了？不，堡垒计划开始

lines.en: Ugh, look outside. It's been raining since Friday.
lines.zh: 唉，看外面。从周五就开始下了。

lines.en: So much for our bike trip. There goes the whole weekend.
lines.zh: 我们的骑行泡汤了。整个周末都完了。

lines.en: Not so fast. Rainy weekends are secretly the best weekends.
lines.zh: 先别急。下雨的周末其实是最好的周末。

lines.en: You made a plan. The sky made a different plan. Classic weekend story.
lines.zh: 你做好了一个计划。天空做了另一个计划。经典的周末故事。

lines.en: Today: what do you do when the rain ruins everything? Mia has answers. Jake has doubts. The rain doesn't care.
lines.zh: 今天：当雨毁了一切，你怎么办？Mia 有答案，Jake 有怀疑，雨不在乎。

lines.en: Okay, convince me. What's so great about a rainy weekend?
lines.zh: 行，说服我。下雨的周末到底好在哪里？

lines.en: Think about it. No one makes plans, so no guilt. You stay in, watch a movie, build the world's biggest blanket fort...
lines.zh: 你想想。没人约你，所以没有负罪感。宅在家、看电影、搭一个世界上最大的毯子堡垒……

lines.en: A blanket fort? Mia, we're fourteen.
lines.zh: 毯子堡垒？Mia，我们都十四岁了。

lines.en: Fourteen-year-olds make the BEST blanket forts. My little brother joins for ten minutes, gets bored, leaves — and then it's perfect.
lines.zh: 十四岁搭的毯子堡垒最棒。我弟加入十分钟就无聊走了——然后就完美了。

lines.en: Ha! Okay, that's actually true. But my mom will say: 'You have homework.'
lines.zh: 哈！行吧，这话倒是真的。但我妈会说：“你有作业。”

lines.en: So do homework inside the fort. Homework plus blanket fort equals... homework, but cozy.
lines.zh: 那就把作业搬进堡垒里写。作业加毯子堡垒等于……作业，但是很 cozy。

lines.en: You've thought about this a lot, haven't you?
lines.zh: 这事你想了很多吧？

lines.en: Every rainy Saturday of my life. Bring your math book. I'll make hot chocolate.
lines.zh: 我人生里每个下雨的周六。带上你的数学书，我来做热巧克力。

lines.en: Deal. Should I bring anything else?
lines.zh: 成交。还要带别的吗？

lines.en: Snacks. Fort rule number one: whoever complains about the rain has to share their snacks.
lines.zh: 零食。堡垒第一条规矩：谁抱怨下雨，谁就得分享零食。

lines.en: That's not a real rule.
lines.zh: 这不是真规矩。

lines.en: It is now.
lines.zh: 从现在开始是了。

lines.en: Saturday morning. The fort is up. And there's a knock at the door — someone new wants in.
lines.zh: 周六早上。堡垒搭好了。有人敲门——一个新成员想加入。

lines.en: Guys, I'm here! Wow. This is... actually impressive. There are pillows.
lines.zh: 我来了！哇。这……确实厉害。还有枕头。

lines.en: Welcome to Fort Sunday. Shoes off, and keep your opinions about the rain to yourself.
lines.zh: 欢迎来到星期日堡垒。脱鞋，关于雨的看法请自己保留。

lines.en: My mom says thanks for inviting me — oh, and she sent dumplings. Frozen ones. She said, 'just boil them.'
lines.zh: 我妈说谢谢你们叫我——哦，她让我带了饺子。速冻的。她说：“煮一下就行。”

lines.en: Your mom is a legend.
lines.zh: 你妈是个传奇。

lines.en: Okay, movie time. Mia, what are we watching?
lines.zh: 好，看电影时间。Mia，我们看什么？

lines.en: The rule of fort movies: something a little bit scary, a little bit funny, and absolutely no homework in the first twenty minutes.
lines.zh: 堡垒电影法则：有点吓人、有点好笑，并且前二十分钟绝对不许写作业。

lines.en: I brought two movies and my dad's popcorn machine.
lines.zh: 我带了两部电影，还有我爸的爆米花机。

lines.en: Leo. Leo, buddy. You might have the best family in this city.
lines.zh: Leo。Leo，兄弟。你家的家庭配置可能是全市第一。

lines.en: I know. Tell me something I don't know.
lines.zh: 我知道。说点我不知道的。

lines.en: Before we slow things down — a few cozy lines for rainy days.
lines.zh: 放慢之前——几句适合下雨天的暖心表达。

lines.en: It's been raining since Friday.
lines.zh: 从周五就一直下雨。

lines.en: So much for our bike trip.
lines.zh: 我们的骑行算是泡汤了。

lines.en: Not so fast.
lines.zh: 先别急着下结论。

lines.en: Deal.
lines.zh: 成交。

lines.en: So much for...
lines.zh: ……算是泡汤了。

lines.en: There goes the whole weekend.
lines.zh: 整个周末就这样没了。

lines.en: Not so fast.
lines.zh: 先别急。

lines.en: You've thought about this a lot, haven't you?
lines.zh: 这事你想了很多吧？

lines.en: Deal.
lines.zh: 成交。

lines.en: Fort rule number one
lines.zh: 堡垒第一条规矩（自创规矩的幽默）

lines.en: That's not a real rule. — It is now.
lines.zh: 这不是真规矩。——从现在起是了。

lines.en: Your mom is a legend.
lines.zh: 你妈是个传奇。

lines.en: Rainy day challenge: describe your perfect indoor day in English — what you'd watch, eat, and build. Forty seconds, out loud.
lines.zh: 雨天挑战：用英语描述你完美的宅家一天——看什么、吃什么、搭什么。四十秒，大声说。

lines.en: Next time, the rain stops and we hit the basketball court — where Jake hears the strangest job offer of his life. See you!
lines.zh: 下一集，雨停了，我们去篮球场——Jake 将在那里听到他人生中最奇怪的招募。再见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 放学篮球局
episodes.desc: 三对三、一场险胜和新队友的诞生

lines.en: Jake! You're on my team today. And try to actually catch the ball this time.
lines.zh: Jake！你今天在我队。这次争取把球接住行吗。

lines.en: That was ONE time, Leo. One time!
lines.zh: 那只有一次，Leo。一次！

lines.en: It's in my memory forever. Let's go.
lines.zh: 它永远留在我的记忆里。走吧。

lines.en: Sports after school. Fresh air, loud friends, and one life skill nobody teaches you in class: how to invite a stranger to play.
lines.zh: 放学后的运动。新鲜空气、吵闹的朋友，还有一项课堂上学不到的生活技能：怎么邀请陌生人一起玩。

lines.en: Alright, teams of three. Me, Jake and Emma against Mia, Dan and... wait, where's Dan?
lines.zh: 好，三人一队。我、Jake、Emma，对 Mia、Dan 和……等等，Dan 呢？

lines.en: He texted me. He's at his grandma's. So we're five — three on two?
lines.zh: 他发消息说在奶奶家。那我们一共五个人——三对二？

lines.en: Or we ask that guy over there. He's been watching us for ten minutes.
lines.zh: 或者问问那边那个人。他已经看我们看了十分钟了。

lines.en: Excuse me! Do you play? Three on three — we need one more!
lines.zh: 你好！你打球吗？三对三——我们还差一个！

lines.en: He's coming over. See? Worst case, you just ask.
lines.zh: 他过来了。看吧？大不了就是开口问一下。

lines.en: New guy, you're with us. What's your name?
lines.zh: 新来的，你跟我们一队。你叫什么？

lines.en: Kevin. Nice.
lines.zh: Kevin。很高兴认识。

lines.en: Kevin, rule one: pass to Jake, he misses, we all pretend it was part of the plan.
lines.zh: Kevin，第一条规矩：传球给 Jake，他没进，我们就都假装那是战术的一部分。

lines.en: I can HEAR you.
lines.zh: 我听得见。

lines.en: First to eleven wins. Losers buy drinks!
lines.zh: 先到十一分获胜。输的买饮料！

lines.en: Game on.
lines.zh: 开打。

lines.en: Forty minutes later. The score is close. The drinks are on someone. Let's listen.
lines.zh: 四十分钟后。比分胶着。饮料有人要请了。来听。

lines.en: Eleven to ten. That was the closest game of my life.
lines.zh: 十一比十。这是我人生中最胶着的一场比赛。

lines.en: My legs are noodles. Actual noodles.
lines.zh: 我的腿是面条。真的面条。

lines.en: Drinks on you two. Water for me, please — I'm saving my money for the school fair.
lines.zh: 你们俩请客。我要水——我在为学校义卖攒钱。

lines.en: Careful, Mia. You might save enough to buy the whole fair.
lines.zh: 省着点，Mia。你可能会攒到把整个义卖都买下来。

lines.en: Same time next Friday? And Kevin — you're officially on the team now.
lines.zh: 下周五老时间？还有 Kevin——你现在是正式队员了。

lines.en: Wait, there's a team? Since when?
lines.zh: 等等，还有队？什么时候有的？

lines.en: Since ten seconds ago. Congratulations.
lines.zh: 十秒钟前刚成立的。恭喜。

lines.en: Best job offer I've ever had.
lines.zh: 这是我收到过的最好的工作邀约。

lines.en: Before we slow down, here's the courtside vocabulary.
lines.zh: 放慢之前，来学球场边的表达。

lines.en: Do you play?
lines.zh: 你打球吗？

lines.en: We need one more!
lines.zh: 我们还差一个人！

lines.en: First to eleven wins.
lines.zh: 先到十一分获胜。

lines.en: Game on.
lines.zh: 开打。

lines.en: You're on my team today.
lines.zh: 你今天在我这队。

lines.en: Do you play?
lines.zh: 你打球吗？

lines.en: Worst case, you just ask.
lines.zh: 最坏的情况也就是开口问一下。

lines.en: Game on.
lines.zh: 开打。

lines.en: Drinks on you.
lines.zh: 饮料你请。

lines.en: Same time next Friday?
lines.zh: 下周五老时间？

lines.en: Since when?
lines.zh: 什么时候开始的？（惊讶）

lines.en: Best offer I've ever had.
lines.zh: 我收到过最好的邀约。

lines.en: Sports challenge: in English, describe your favorite way to move — running, dancing, swimming, anything. Say why you love it and when you do it.
lines.zh: 运动挑战：用英语描述你最喜欢的运动方式——跑步、跳舞、游泳都行。说出你为什么喜欢、什么时候做。

lines.en: Next time: Jake and Mia take a bus to the Science Museum. It should take twenty minutes. It takes... longer. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 下一集：Jake 和 Mia 坐公交去科技馆。本该二十分钟。结果用了……久一点。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 迷路奇遇
episodes.desc: 拿反的地图、热心的路人和一堂问路课

lines.en: Mia. Mia. Stop walking. Look at this street. Do you see any of these buildings on the map?
lines.zh: Mia。Mia。别走了。看这条街。地图上有这些楼里的任何一栋吗？

lines.en: Hmm. No. Okay. Don't panic, but... I think we took the wrong bus.
lines.zh: 嗯。没有。好。先别慌，但是……我觉得我们坐错车了。

lines.en: We've been walking for forty minutes, Mia.
lines.zh: 我们已经走了四十分钟了，Mia。

lines.en: Today's episode: getting lost, and the skill that saves you every time — asking for help.
lines.zh: 今天的节目：迷路，以及每次都能救你的那项技能——开口求助。

lines.en: How? You had the map open the whole time!
lines.zh: 怎么会？你一路上地图都开着呢！

lines.en: I did! But the map was upside down, so 'left' was actually 'right'...
lines.zh: 我确实开着！但地图拿反了，所以“左”其实是“右”……

lines.en: For forty minutes, Mia. We've been walking for forty minutes.
lines.zh: 整整四十分钟，Mia。我们走了四十分钟了。

lines.en: In our defense, it was a very interesting forty minutes. Did you see that cat café?
lines.zh: 凭良心说，这四十分钟还挺有意思的。你看到那家猫咖了吗？

lines.en: I did see it. We walked past it three times.
lines.zh: 我看到了。我们路过它三次。

lines.en: Okay, okay. New plan. Let's ask someone. That lady looks friendly.
lines.zh: 好好好。新计划。我们问人吧。那位女士看起来很友善。

lines.en: Excuse me, hi — sorry to bother you. We're trying to get to the Science Museum. Are we far?
lines.zh: 您好，打扰一下。我们想去科技馆，还远吗？

lines.en: Oh, you're close! But you went the wrong way at the last crossing. Go back, turn right at the bakery, and it's the big glass building on your left.
lines.zh: 哦，很近了！但你们在上个路口走反了。往回走，在面包店右转，左手边那栋大玻璃楼就是。

lines.en: Back, right at the bakery, big glass building. Got it. Thank you so much!
lines.zh: 往回、面包店右转、大玻璃楼。记住了。太感谢了！

lines.en: No worries, dear. It happens to everyone — this neighborhood all looks the same.
lines.zh: 没事的，孩子。人人都遇到过——这一带的楼长得都一样。

lines.en: See? Asking is faster than guessing. That's lesson one of getting lost.
lines.zh: 看吧？开口问比瞎猜快。这是迷路第一课。

lines.en: Lesson two: never let Mia hold the map.
lines.zh: 第二课：永远别让 Mia 拿地图。

lines.en: The map was FINE. It was upside down, but it was fine.
lines.zh: 地图好好的。是拿反了，但它好好的。

lines.en: Twenty minutes later — after one more wrong turn, but who's counting — they arrive.
lines.zh: 二十分钟后——再多拐错一次弯之后，不过谁在数呢——他们到了。

lines.en: There it is! The glass building! We made it, and we're only twenty minutes late.
lines.zh: 在那儿！玻璃大楼！我们到了，只迟到了二十分钟。

lines.en: See? Character-building. Anyway — look, they have a robot section.
lines.zh: 看吧？磨练意志。总之——看，有机器人展区。

lines.en: Mia. It's a science museum. They have six robot sections.
lines.zh: Mia。这是科技馆。他们有六个机器人展区。

lines.en: Then today is the best day of my life.
lines.zh: 那今天是我人生中最好的一天。

lines.en: Before we slow things down — the four sentences that will save you in any city on Earth.
lines.zh: 放慢之前——这四句话能在地球上任何城市救你。

lines.en: Excuse me, sorry to bother you.
lines.zh: 您好，打扰一下。

lines.en: We're trying to get to the Science Museum.
lines.zh: 我们想去科技馆。

lines.en: Are we far?
lines.zh: 还远吗？

lines.en: Turn right at the bakery.
lines.zh: 在面包店右转。

lines.en: Excuse me, sorry to bother you.
lines.zh: 您好，打扰一下。

lines.en: We're trying to get to ...
lines.zh: 我们想去……

lines.en: Are we far?
lines.zh: 还远吗？

lines.en: Go back and turn right.
lines.zh: 往回走然后右转。

lines.en: It's on your left.
lines.zh: 在你左手边。

lines.en: Thank you so much!
lines.zh: 太感谢了！

lines.en: No worries.
lines.zh: 没事的。

lines.en: Asking is faster than guessing.
lines.zh: 开口问比瞎猜快。

lines.en: Look at a map of your neighborhood and describe one route in English: go straight, turn left at..., it's on your right. Out loud, twice.
lines.zh: 看一张你家附近的地图，用英语描述一条路线：直走、在……左转、它在你右手边。大声说两遍。

lines.en: Next time: Jake catches nine colds in one classroom, and finally visits the doctor. Bring tissues. See you!
lines.zh: 下一集：Jake 在教室里打了九个喷嚏，终于去看了医生。备好纸巾。再见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 看医生
episodes.desc: 喷嚏、喉咙痛和一句“医生说不行”

lines.en: Achoo! ...Ugh.
lines.zh: 阿嚏！……唉。

lines.en: Bless you. Jake, you've sneezed nine times since first class. Go to the doctor.
lines.zh: 保佑你。Jake，第一节课到现在你打了九个喷嚏了。去看医生吧。

lines.en: It's just a cold. I'll be fine by Friday.
lines.zh: 就是普通感冒。周五之前肯定好。

lines.en: Everyone gets sick sometimes. Today's episode: being honest about how you feel — and what the doctor actually says.
lines.zh: 人人都会生病。今天的节目：诚实地描述你的感受——以及医生到底会说什么。

lines.en: You said that on Monday. It's Wednesday, Jake.
lines.zh: 周一你也是这么说的。今天是周三了，Jake。

lines.en: Okay, it's a stubborn cold. Still just a cold.
lines.zh: 好吧，这是个顽固的感冒。但也就是感冒。

lines.en: Be honest. How do you feel right now?
lines.zh: 说实话。你现在感觉怎么样？

lines.en: Honestly? My head feels like a drum, and my throat hurts when I talk.
lines.zh: 说实话？我的头像鼓一样，说话的时候喉咙也疼。

lines.en: Then go. Today. Ask your mom to take you to the clinic after school.
lines.zh: 那就去。今天去。让你妈放学后带你去诊所。

lines.en: Okay, okay, you win. But if the doctor says it's nothing, I get to say 'I told you so.'
lines.zh: 好好好，你赢了。但要是医生说没事，我就可以说“我早说过吧”。

lines.en: Deal. Now go before you sneeze on someone again.
lines.zh: 成交。趁你还没再喷嚏喷到谁，快去吧。

lines.en: After school, Jake's mom takes him to the clinic. Inside room three, the doctor asks the question every patient hears first.
lines.zh: 放学后，Jake 妈妈带他去了诊所。三号诊室里，医生问了每个病人都会先被问到的问题。

lines.en: Hello, young man. What brings you in today?
lines.zh: 你好，小伙子。今天哪里不舒服？

lines.en: I've had a cough since Monday, and a headache since yesterday. And I'm really tired.
lines.zh: 我从周一开始咳嗽，昨天开始头疼。而且特别累。

lines.en: Any fever?
lines.zh: 发烧吗？

lines.en: I don't know. My mom measured this morning — thirty-seven point eight.
lines.zh: 不知道。我妈早上量了——三十七度八。

lines.en: A little one. Let me listen to your lungs. Breathe in... and out. Again. Good.
lines.zh: 有一点低烧。我听听你的肺。吸气……呼气。再来。好。

lines.en: Okay. It's a common cold, nothing serious. But you should rest for two days and drink lots of warm water.
lines.zh: 好了。是普通感冒，不严重。但要休息两天，多喝温水。

lines.en: Do I need medicine?
lines.zh: 需要吃药吗？

lines.en: Just this — one pill after dinner, for three days. And no basketball until the fever is gone. Understood?
lines.zh: 只要这个——晚饭后一片，吃三天。退烧之前不许打篮球。明白吗？

lines.en: Not even a little basketball?
lines.zh: 一点点篮球也不行？

lines.en: Doctor's orders. Rest is also medicine — and it's free.
lines.zh: 医嘱。休息也是药——而且是免费的。

lines.en: That's the most unfair rule I've ever heard. But okay. Thanks, doctor.
lines.zh: 这是我听过最不公平的规定。但好吧。谢谢医生。

lines.en: Before we slow down — how to describe a cold like a pro.
lines.zh: 放慢之前——像老手一样描述感冒。

lines.en: What brings you in today?
lines.zh: 今天哪里不舒服？

lines.en: I've had a cough since Monday.
lines.zh: 我从周一开始咳嗽。

lines.en: Any fever?
lines.zh: 发烧吗？

lines.en: Doctor's orders.
lines.zh: 医嘱。

lines.en: It's just a cold.
lines.zh: 只是普通感冒。

lines.en: How do you feel right now?
lines.zh: 你现在感觉怎么样？

lines.en: My throat hurts when I talk.
lines.zh: 我说话时喉咙疼。

lines.en: I've had a cough since Monday.
lines.zh: 我从周一开始咳嗽。

lines.en: Any fever?
lines.zh: 发烧吗？

lines.en: nothing serious
lines.zh: 不严重

lines.en: Doctor's orders.
lines.zh: 医嘱。

lines.en: Rest is also medicine.
lines.zh: 休息也是药。

lines.en: Health challenge: if you felt sick today, describe it in English — where it hurts, since when, how bad. If you feel great, say why. Out loud.
lines.zh: 健康挑战：如果你今天不舒服，用英语描述它——哪里疼、从什么时候开始、多严重。如果你状态很好，说说为什么。大声说。

lines.en: Next time: a secret birthday plan, a chocolate cake, and the hardest rule of all — nobody posts anything online. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 下一集：一个秘密生日计划、一个巧克力蛋糕，以及最难的一条规矩——不许发任何东西上网。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 惊喜生日会
episodes.desc: 保密难度五颗星的生日计划

lines.en: Emma's birthday is on Saturday. Are we doing a surprise party or not?
lines.zh: Emma 周六生日。惊喜派对到底办不办？

lines.en: We ARE. But we have to plan it without her finding out. You know how she is.
lines.zh: 办。但我们得计划得天衣无缝，不能让她发现。你知道她的。

lines.en: She found out about her own Christmas present last year. She read the email over her dad's shoulder.
lines.zh: 她去年连自己的圣诞礼物都提前发现了。凑在她爸肩膀后面看的邮件。

lines.en: Planning a surprise party takes three skills: a good plan, a backup plan, and the ability to keep a secret. Today, all three are tested.
lines.zh: 策划惊喜派对需要三种能力：好计划、备用计划，还有保守秘密的能力。今天，三种全部接受考验。

lines.en: Okay, first: the cake. Chocolate or fruit?
lines.zh: 好，第一：蛋糕。巧克力还是水果的？

lines.en: Chocolate. It's not up for debate. Emma would choose chocolate in her sleep.
lines.zh: 巧克力。这没有讨论余地。Emma 睡着了都会选巧克力。

lines.en: Agreed. Chocolate cake with strawberries on top. Second: where? My place is small.
lines.zh: 同意。巧克力蛋糕，上面放草莓。第二：在哪儿办？我家太小。

lines.en: What about the park? If it doesn't rain — picnic tables, balloons, and Leo brings his speaker.
lines.zh: 公园怎么样？要是不下雨——野餐桌、气球，Leo 带他的音箱来。

lines.en: And if it rains?
lines.zh: 那要是下雨呢？

lines.en: Backup plan: Leo's garage. It's big and his parents don't mind.
lines.zh: 备用计划：Leo 家车库。很大，他爸妈也不介意。

lines.en: You've already talked to Leo, haven't you?
lines.zh: 你已经跟 Leo 说过了吧？

lines.en: I texted him an hour ago. He said, and I quote, 'I was born ready.'
lines.zh: 我一小时前就发消息了。他说，原话是：“我生下来就准备好了。”

lines.en: Guest list? Whole class, or keep it small?
lines.zh: 客人名单？全班都请，还是小型？

lines.en: Small. Twelve people, max. Big parties stress Emma out.
lines.zh: 小型。最多十二个人。大型派对会让 Emma 有压力。

lines.en: Good point. I'll make a group chat tonight, and everyone brings one snack.
lines.zh: 有道理。我今晚建个群，每人带一样零食。

lines.en: Perfect. Oh — and one rule. NOBODY posts anything online until Sunday.
lines.zh: 完美。哦——还有一条规矩。周日之前谁都不许发网上。

lines.en: Not even a story?
lines.zh: 发个限时动态也不行？

lines.en: Not even a story. Her sister spies for us, but her cousin... her cousin cannot be trusted.
lines.zh: 动态也不行。她妹妹是我们这边的卧底，但她表姐……她表姐守不住秘密。

lines.en: Saturday afternoon. The park. The cake is here. The balloons are up. And Emma is about to arrive.
lines.zh: 周六下午。公园。蛋糕到位。气球挂好。Emma 马上就到。

lines.en: Shh, shh! She's coming! Everyone hide!
lines.zh: 嘘嘘！她来了！大家躲起来！

lines.en: Lights off! Lights off!
lines.zh: 关灯！关灯！

lines.en: Why are all the lights off? Hello...? Guys? This isn't funny—
lines.zh: 怎么灯全关了？喂……？你们呢？不好玩啊——

lines.en: SURPRISE! HAPPY BIRTHDAY!
lines.zh: 惊喜！生日快乐！

lines.en: You GUYS! Oh my goodness — wait. Is that chocolate cake? With strawberries?
lines.zh: 你们这些家伙！我的天——等等。那是巧克力蛋糕吗？还有草莓？

lines.en: Your favorites. Happy birthday, Emma.
lines.zh: 都是你的最爱。生日快乐，Emma。

lines.en: I actually might cry. Okay, no, I'm fine. Group hug! Come on!
lines.zh: 我真的可能会哭。好，没事，我没事。抱一个！都过来！

lines.en: Before we slow down — the vocabulary of a perfect surprise.
lines.zh: 放慢之前——一场完美惊喜的词汇表。

lines.en: Are we doing a surprise party or not?
lines.zh: 惊喜派对到底办不办？

lines.en: It's not up for debate.
lines.zh: 这没有讨论余地。

lines.en: And if it rains?
lines.zh: 那要是下雨呢？

lines.en: Nobody posts anything online.
lines.zh: 谁都不许发网上。

lines.en: Are we ... or not?
It's not up for debate.
lines.zh: 没有讨论余地。

lines.en: Good point.
lines.zh: 有道理。

lines.en: Backup plan
lines.zh: 备用计划

lines.en: and I quote
lines.zh: 原话是（引用某人的话）

lines.en: Big parties stress her out.
lines.zh: 大型派对让她有压力。

lines.en: Not even a story.
lines.zh: 动态也不行。

lines.en: Group hug!
lines.zh: 一起抱一个！

lines.en: Plan your dream party in English, out loud: where, when, what food, who comes, and your backup plan. One minute.
lines.zh: 用英语大声策划你的梦想派对：在哪、何时、吃什么、谁参加，还有你的备用计划。一分钟。

lines.en: Next time: Grandma, tea eggs, and a train that leaves at nine fifteen — not nine. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 下一集：奶奶、茶叶蛋，和一班九点十五——不是九点——发车的火车。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 火车去奶奶家
episodes.desc: 改点的车票、茶叶蛋和一个文件夹

lines.en: Mom said the train leaves at nine, right? Not eight? Because I checked the tickets and—
lines.zh: 妈说火车九点发车对吧？不是八点？因为我看了票……

lines.en: Nine fifteen. It got changed last week. Why? What time did you tell your dad?
lines.zh: 九点十五。上周改的。怎么了？你跟你爸说的是几点？

lines.en: ...Eight. I told him eight. He's going to be there at seven thirty with sandwiches.
lines.zh: ……八点。我跟他说八点。他会七点半就带着三明治站在那儿了。

lines.en: Train stations: big boards, small panics, and grandmas who always have snacks.
lines.zh: 火车站：巨大的屏幕、小小的心慌，还有永远有零食的奶奶。

lines.en: Relax, the train is at nine fifteen, we're an hour early. Want a sandwich?
lines.zh: 放松，火车九点十五，我们早到了一小时。要三明治吗？

lines.en: We're not an hour early, we're forty minutes early. And no — I ate a sandwich at six a.m. Out of panic.
lines.zh: 我们不是早一小时，是早了四十分钟。不吃——我早上六点出于恐慌吃了一个三明治。

lines.en: That's the most Jake thing you've ever said. Okay, tickets?
lines.zh: 这是你说过的最有 Jake 味的一句话。好，票呢？

lines.en: Got them — all three, in this folder, in order. Me, you, Grandma.
lines.zh: 拿到了——三张都在这个文件夹里，按顺序。我、你、奶奶。

lines.en: You made a folder.
lines.zh: 你还做了个文件夹。

lines.en: I made a folder. Grandma loses things. It's her superpower.
lines.zh: 我做了个文件夹。奶奶会丢东西。这是她的超能力。

lines.en: Speaking of Grandma — platform change! Look, the board says platform three now.
lines.zh: 说到奶奶——站台变了！看，大屏说改到三站台了。

lines.en: Already? Ugh, fine. Grab the bags — wait, where's Grandma?
lines.zh: 又改？行吧行吧。拿上包——等等，奶奶呢？

lines.en: She's buying tea eggs. Jake. She will buy tea eggs for exactly one more minute, and then wonder where we are.
lines.zh: 她在买茶叶蛋。Jake。她还会再买整整一分钟，然后开始纳闷我们去哪了。

lines.en: Then we run. On three. One, two—
lines.zh: 那我们跑。数到三。一、二——

lines.en: GRANDMA! WE'RE OVER HERE!
lines.zh: 奶奶！我们在这儿！

lines.en: On the train now. Two hours and forty minutes of river views, stories, and one big food surprise.
lines.zh: 现在火车开了。两小时四十分钟的河景、故事，和一个大大的食物惊喜。

lines.en: Jake, dear, your ticket. Seat twelve, by the window?
lines.zh: Jake，好孩子，你的票。十二座，靠窗？

lines.en: That's yours, Grandma — twelve, by the window. I'm in thirteen.
lines.zh: 那是您的票，奶奶——十二座靠窗。我在十三座。

lines.en: Wow, Jake, look at that river! How long until we arrive?
lines.zh: 哇，Jake，看那条河！还有多久到？

lines.en: Two hours and forty minutes. If you get bored, I downloaded three movies for you.
lines.zh: 两小时四十分钟。您要是无聊，我给您下载了三部电影。

lines.en: You're a good boy, you know that? Now — I packed us something. Don't tell your mother.
lines.zh: 你是个好孩子，知道吗？现在——我给咱们带了点东西。别告诉你妈。

lines.en: Grandma. Is that— are those tea eggs?
lines.zh: 奶奶。那是——那是茶叶蛋吗？

lines.en: Six of them. One for each hour of the trip, and two for luck.
lines.zh: 六个。旅途每小时一个，另外两个图个吉利。

lines.en: The trip is less than three hours.
lines.zh: 这趟车不到三小时。

lines.en: Then we'll be very lucky.
lines.zh: 那我们会非常幸运。

lines.en: Before we slow things down — travel words that work on any train, in any country.
lines.zh: 放慢之前——在任何国家、任何火车上都用得上的旅行词汇。

lines.en: The train leaves at nine fifteen.
lines.zh: 火车九点十五发车。

lines.en: Platform three now.
lines.zh: 现在改到三站台了。

lines.en: How long until we arrive?
lines.zh: 还有多久到？

lines.en: Don't tell your mother.
lines.zh: 别告诉你妈。

lines.en: The train leaves at ...
lines.zh: 火车……点发车。

lines.en: It got changed last week.
lines.zh: 上周改了。

lines.en: Platform change!
lines.zh: 站台变了！

lines.en: Speaking of ...
lines.zh: 说到……

lines.en: Grab the bags!
lines.zh: 拿上包！

lines.en: We're over here!
lines.zh: 我们在这儿！

lines.en: How long until we arrive?
lines.zh: 还有多久到？

lines.en: for luck
lines.zh: 图个吉利

lines.en: Describe your last trip in English: where you went, how long it took, and one funny thing that happened. One minute, out loud.
lines.zh: 用英语描述你上次出行：去了哪、花了多久、发生的一件趣事。一分钟，大声说。

lines.en: Next time: Biscuit the dog sees a squirrel, jumps the fence, and becomes a neighborhood mystery. See you!
lines.zh: 下一集：小狗饼干看到一只松鼠、翻过栅栏，成了整个社区的悬案。再见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 小狗走丢了
episodes.desc: 松鼠嫌疑犯、寻狗启事和一个反转结局

lines.en: Mia, this is serious. Biscuit jumped the fence this morning and he hasn't come back.
lines.zh: Mia，这次是认真的。小狗饼干今天早上翻过了栅栏，到现在没回来。

lines.en: Since when? What time did you last see him?
lines.zh: 什么时候的事？你最后一次见到他是几点？

lines.en: Seven. He saw a squirrel, and, well... you know Biscuit.
lines.zh: 七点。他看见一只松鼠，然后……你懂饼干的。

lines.en: Losing a pet is scary. But panic doesn't find dogs — plans do. Today, Mia brings the plans.
lines.zh: 宠物丢了很吓人。但恐慌找不到狗——计划才能。今天，Mia 负责计划。

lines.en: Okay. Don't worry. Dogs come back. But let's not just wait. What does he love most?
lines.zh: 好。别慌。狗会回来的。但咱们不能干等。他最爱什么？

lines.en: Food. Squeaky toys. Food. Did I say food?
lines.zh: 吃的。会叫的玩具。吃的。我说过吃了吗？

lines.en: Plan one: walk around the block with his squeaky toy and call him.
lines.zh: 计划一：拿着他的玩具绕街区走一圈，边走边喊他。

lines.en: Already did. Twice. A lady asked if I was recruiting for a dog band.
lines.zh: 已经做过了。两次。有位女士问我是不是在给一支狗狗乐队招人。

lines.en: Plan two: we make posters. A photo, his name, your mom's phone number.
lines.zh: 计划二：做寻狗启事。照片、名字、你妈妈的电话。

lines.en: I have a photo. Look — here he is stealing my sandwich.
lines.zh: 我有照片。看——这是他在偷我三明治。

lines.en: That's... an amazing photo, but not for a poster. We need his face. Okay — print ten. We'll put them at the school gate and the park.
lines.zh: 这照片……很精彩，但不适合做启事。要他的正脸。好——打印十张，贴校门口和公园。

lines.en: And the squirrel?
lines.zh: 那松鼠呢？

lines.en: The squirrel is a suspect, Jake. Not a location.
lines.zh: 松鼠是嫌疑人，Jake。不是地点。

lines.en: Two hours of searching. No dog. And then — the phone rings.
lines.zh: 两个小时的寻找。没有狗。然后——电话响了。

lines.en: Mia! MIA! Answer your phone!
lines.zh: Mia！MIA！接电话！

lines.en: What happened?! Did you find him?
lines.zh: 怎么了？！找到他了吗？

lines.en: Better. He found HIMSELF. He was at the school gate, sitting next to his own poster, waiting for someone to read it.
lines.zh: 还有更好的。他自己找到了自己。他在校门口，坐在自己的寻狗启事旁边，等人来读。

lines.en: You're joking.
lines.zh: 你逗我呢。

lines.en: I'm not! The guard fed him a bun. He's home. He's eating. He's a criminal and I love him.
lines.zh: 没有！门卫喂了他一个馒头。他到家了。正在吃。他是个罪犯，我爱死他了。

lines.en: Okay, from now on: fence fixed, and no squirrels on weekends.
lines.zh: 好，从现在起：修好栅栏，周末禁止松鼠出现。

lines.en: I'll inform the squirrels personally.
lines.zh: 我会亲自通知松鼠们的。

lines.en: Before we slow down — how to talk about a lost pet without panicking.
lines.zh: 放慢之前——怎么在不慌乱的情况下谈论走丢的宠物。

lines.en: He hasn't come back yet.
lines.zh: 他还没回来。

lines.en: What time did you last see him?
lines.zh: 你最后一次见到他是几点？

lines.en: We need his face for the poster.
lines.zh: 启事上得有他的正脸。

lines.en: He's home safe.
lines.zh: 他安全到家了。

lines.en: This is serious.
lines.zh: 这次是认真的。

lines.en: Since when?
lines.zh: 什么时候开始的？

lines.en: Don't worry. Dogs come back.
lines.zh: 别慌。狗会回来的。

lines.en: Plan one / Plan two
lines.zh: 计划一／计划二

lines.en: You're joking.
lines.zh: 你逗我呢。

lines.en: He's a criminal and I love him.
lines.zh: 他是个罪犯，但我爱他（又气又爱）。

lines.en: From now on
lines.zh: 从现在起

lines.en: I'll inform them personally.
lines.zh: 我会亲自通知他们。

lines.en: Pet challenge: describe a pet — real or imaginary — in English: name, looks, favorite food, and one thing it always does wrong. One minute.
lines.zh: 宠物挑战：用英语描述一只宠物——真实或想象的：名字、长相、最爱的食物，和它总做错的一件事。一分钟。

lines.en: Next time: a science project due Friday, a beautiful title page, and one very organized friend. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 下一集：周五截止的科学作业、一个精美封面，和一位非常有条理的朋友。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 小组作业
episodes.desc: 分工、熬夜和一句“排练过的停顿”

lines.en: So. The science project. Due Friday. Has anyone... actually started?
lines.zh: 那么。科学作业。周五交。有人……真的开始了吗？

lines.en: I made a title page. It's beautiful. It says 'The Water Cycle' in three colors.
lines.zh: 我做了个封面。很漂亮。用三种颜色写着“水循环”。

lines.en: Guys. GUYS. We have four days. Four. Days.
lines.zh: 各位。各位！我们还有四天。四。天。

lines.en: Group projects: where friendship, deadlines, and different ideas of 'started' collide.
lines.zh: 小组作业：友谊、截止日期，以及对“开始了”的不同理解，在这里发生碰撞。

lines.en: Okay, divide and conquer. Emma, you're the artist — posters and drawings.
lines.zh: 好，分头行动。Emma，你是画家——海报和图都归你。

lines.en: On it. I'll do the water cycle diagram tonight.
lines.zh: 马上做。我今晚就把水循环图画出来。

lines.en: Jake, you're good at talking, so the presentation is yours.
lines.zh: Jake，你能说会道，展示讲解归你。

lines.en: Define 'good at talking.'
lines.zh: “能说会道”怎么定义？

lines.en: You talked the PE teacher into giving us extra game time. Twice. You qualify.
lines.zh: 你说服体育老师给我们加了游戏时间。两次。你够格。

lines.en: That's fair. Okay, but I need notes to talk from.
lines.zh: 行吧。但我需要讲稿提纲。

lines.en: I'll write the script tonight. Everyone, same place, tomorrow lunch, bring your parts.
lines.zh: 我今晚写稿。各位，明天午饭老地方，带上各自的部分。

lines.en: What if something goes wrong?
lines.zh: 万一出问题怎么办？

lines.en: Something always goes wrong. That's why we have three days of backup time.
lines.zh: 总会出问题的。所以我们留了三天备用时间。

lines.en: Leo, that's... genuinely wise.
lines.zh: Leo，这……真是智慧。

lines.en: I have two older sisters. I've survived many group projects.
lines.zh: 我有两个姐姐。我在很多小组作业里活下来了。

lines.en: Presentation day. Nerves, a dramatic pause, and a very well-earned grade.
lines.zh: 展示日。紧张、一个戏剧性停顿，和一份实至名归的成绩。

lines.en: Nervous?
lines.zh: 紧张吗？

lines.en: My hands are cold and my brain is empty. Normal levels of nervous.
lines.zh: 手是冷的，脑子是空的。标准紧张水平。

lines.en: You'll be fine. Just remember: slow down, look at them, and if you forget — look at me. I'll mouth the words.
lines.zh: 你没问题。记住：放慢、看着他们、忘了的话——看我。我会口型提示你。

lines.en: You wrote the script. You know it by heart, don't you?
lines.zh: 稿子是你写的。你都能背下来了吧？

lines.en: Leo never forgets the script.
lines.zh: Leo 从不忘稿。

lines.en: And we got an A! An A, guys! Mr. Lee said our teamwork was excellent.
lines.zh: 我们得了 A！A 啊各位！李老师说我们的团队合作非常出色。

lines.en: Teamwork — and Jake's dramatic pause before the big word: evaporation.
lines.zh: 团队合作——还有 Jake 在关键词“蒸发”之前那个戏剧性停顿。

lines.en: I practiced that pause in the mirror. Twice.
lines.zh: 那个停顿我对着镜子练过。两次。

lines.en: We could tell.
lines.zh: 我们看得出来。

lines.en: Before we slow down — how to divide the work like a pro.
lines.zh: 放慢之前——像老手一样分工。

lines.en: Has anyone actually started?
lines.zh: 有人真的开始了吗？

lines.en: Divide and conquer.
lines.zh: 分头行动。

lines.en: The presentation is yours.
lines.zh: 展示讲解归你。

lines.en: What if something goes wrong?
lines.zh: 万一出问题怎么办？

lines.en: Due Friday.
lines.zh: 周五截止。

lines.en: Divide and conquer.
lines.zh: 分头行动。

lines.en: On it.
lines.zh: 马上做。

lines.en: Define ...
lines.zh: ……怎么定义？（幽默反问）

lines.en: That's fair.
lines.zh: 行吧，有道理。

lines.en: Something always goes wrong.
lines.zh: 总会出问题的。

lines.en: You know it by heart.
lines.zh: 你都能背下来了。

lines.en: We could tell.
lines.zh: 我们看得出来。

lines.en: Team challenge: in English, explain your role in your last group task — what you did, what was hard, and what you'd do differently.
lines.zh: 团队挑战：用英语讲你上次小组任务中的角色——你做了什么、难在哪、下次会怎么改。

lines.en: Next time: seven hours of screen time, one very honest friend, and a deal with Mom. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 下一集：七小时屏幕时间、一位非常诚实的朋友，和一份与妈妈的协议。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 手机保卫战
episodes.desc: 七小时的使用报告和一份谈判方案

lines.en: She took my phone, Leo. She said, 'One hour a day, that's it.' I'm going to lose my mind.
lines.zh: 她把手机没收了，Leo。她说“每天一小时，就这些。”我要疯了。

lines.en: Your mom? Why? What happened?
lines.zh: 你妈？为什么？发生什么了？

lines.en: She checked my screen time report. Seven hours on Sunday. SEVEN.
lines.zh: 她看了我的屏幕使用报告。周日七小时。七小时。

lines.en: Phones: tiny rectangles that eat whole weekends. Today — one boy, one report card of shame, and one negotiation.
lines.zh: 手机：吃掉整个周末的小方块。今天——一个男孩、一份“耻辱报告”，和一场谈判。

lines.en: On a school night? Jake. Buddy.
lines.zh: 还是上学日？Jake。兄弟。

lines.en: It was raining! What was I supposed to do, read?
lines.zh: 那天下雨啊！不然我干嘛，看书吗？

lines.en: Honestly? Kind of, yeah.
lines.zh: 说实话？对，就是。

lines.en: You sound like my mom. This is a betrayal.
lines.zh: 你说话像我妈。这是背叛。

lines.en: It's not betrayal, it's math. Seven hours is more than a full school day. Even I know that's too much — and I once watched TV for six hours straight.
lines.zh: 这不是背叛，这是数学。七小时比一整个上学日还长。连我都知道太多了——虽然我最近也连着看了六小时电视。

lines.en: So what do I do? She won't change her mind. She never changes her mind.
lines.zh: 那我怎么办？她不会改主意的。她从不改主意。

lines.en: Then make her a deal. Show her a plan. Homework first, phone after dinner, one hour, and the phone sleeps in the living room at nine.
lines.zh: 那就跟她谈个协议。给她看个计划。作业优先、晚饭后用手机、一小时、九点手机“睡”在客厅。

lines.en: And if she says no?
lines.zh: 那她要说不呢？

lines.en: Then you say: 'Deal or no deal?' — and you look her in the eye.
lines.zh: 那你就说：“协议还是不协议？”——然后直视她的眼睛。

lines.en: That's a TV show, Leo.
lines.zh: 那是档电视节目，Leo。

lines.en: It's also a negotiation. Trust me.
lines.zh: 它也是一种谈判。相信我。

lines.en: One week later. The update — and honestly, nobody expects this one.
lines.zh: 一周后。最新进展——说真的，谁都没想到。

lines.en: Update: the deal worked. Mostly.
lines.zh: 更新：协议生效了。基本上。

lines.en: Mostly?
lines.zh: 基本上？

lines.en: One hour a day on school nights, two on weekends. And guess what — I finished a whole book. A whole one.
lines.zh: 上学日每天一小时，周末两小时。你猜怎么着——我读完了一整本书。一整本。

lines.en: Look at you. Growth.
lines.zh: 看看你。成长了。

lines.en: Don't tell anyone I said this, but... I sleep better. Like, actually wake up rested.
lines.zh: 别跟别人说我说的，但是……我睡得更好了。真的能睡到自然醒那种。

lines.en: The secret's out. Books: better than seven hours of scrolling.
lines.zh: 秘密曝光了。书：胜过七小时刷屏。

lines.en: Never quote me on that.
lines.zh: 这话可别说是我讲的。

lines.en: Before we slow down — the language of making a deal.
lines.zh: 放慢之前——谈协议的语言。

lines.en: One hour a day, that's it.
lines.zh: 每天一小时，就这些。

lines.en: It's not betrayal, it's math.
lines.zh: 这不是背叛，这是数学。

lines.en: Then make her a deal.
lines.zh: 那就跟她谈个协议。

lines.en: Deal or no deal?
lines.zh: 协议成不成？

lines.en: You will not believe...
lines.zh: 你绝对不敢相信……

lines.en: She never changes her mind.
lines.zh: 她从不改主意。

lines.en: It's not betrayal, it's math.
lines.zh: 这不是背叛，是数学。

lines.en: Make her a deal.
lines.zh: 跟她谈个协议。

lines.en: Trust me.
lines.zh: 相信我。

lines.en: Guess what —
lines.zh: 你猜怎么着——

lines.en: The secret's out.
lines.zh: 秘密曝光了。

lines.en: Never quote me on that.
lines.zh: 别说是我说的。

lines.en: Make your own screen-time deal — say it in English: homework first, phone after dinner, one hour, phone sleeps at nine. Out loud, tonight.
lines.zh: 给自己定一份屏幕时间协议——用英语说：作业优先、晚饭后用手机、一小时、九点手机睡觉。今晚大声说。

lines.en: Next time: the school talent show, a secret solo, and a USB stick full of stage lights. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 下一集：校园才艺秀、一个秘密独奏，和一个装满舞台灯光的 U 盘。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 才艺秀之夜
episodes.desc: 秘密排练、全场大合唱和半根手指的颤抖

lines.en: Two days until the talent show and Leo has a SOLO. Did you know? Did HE know?
lines.zh: 还有两天就才艺秀了，Leo 有个独奏。你知道吗？他自己知道吗？

lines.en: He said, and I quote, 'it's a small thing, no big deal.' He's been practicing in the music room every lunch this week.
lines.zh: 他说，原话是：“小事一桩。”他这周每天中午都在音乐室练习。

lines.en: That is not 'small thing' energy.
lines.zh: 这可不像“小事一桩”的能量。

lines.en: Stage fright, secret rehearsals, and one song the whole school remembers. Today: the talent show.
lines.zh: 怯场、秘密排练，和一首全校都记得的歌。今天：才艺秀。

lines.en: It's just a small thing. Two minutes. I play, people clap, we go home.
lines.zh: 就是件小事。两分钟。我弹，大家鼓掌，我们回家。

lines.en: Leo. You downloaded stage lights. On a USB stick. That is not 'small thing' energy.
lines.zh: Leo。你下载了舞台灯光。在一个 U 盘里。这可完全不是“小事”的能量。

lines.en: What are you playing? Tell us, or we find out on stage like everyone else.
lines.zh: 你要弹什么？快说，不然我们就跟所有人一样在台下知道了。

lines.en: Fine. It's the song from that cartoon we all watched in fifth grade.
lines.zh: 好吧。是我们五年级都看过的那部动画片里的歌。

lines.en: No. You're kidding. The one with—
lines.zh: 不。你逗我。那首有——

lines.en: Yes. The theme song. The FULL theme song.
lines.zh: 对。主题曲。完整版主题曲。

lines.en: The whole school is going to lose their minds.
lines.zh: 全校都会疯掉的。

lines.en: That's the plan. But listen — if I mess up, no one mentions it. Ever.
lines.zh: 计划就是这样。但听着——要是我弹砸了，谁都不许提。永远不许。

lines.en: Deal. And if you don't mess up?
lines.zh: 成交。那要是你没砸呢？

lines.en: Then you can mention it. Forever, actually.
lines.zh: 那你们就可以提。而且是永远地提。

lines.en: Show night. The lights go down. And then — you'll hear what happened, straight from the people who were there.
lines.zh: 演出之夜。灯光暗下。然后——你们会从在场的当事人嘴里，听到发生了什么。

lines.en: YOU WERE AMAZING. The teachers were singing along! THE TEACHERS, LEO.
lines.zh: 你太棒了！老师们都跟着唱了！老师们啊，Leo！

lines.en: My hands are still shaking. Look. Look at them.
lines.zh: 我的手还在抖。看。看看。

lines.en: You didn't miss a single note. Not one.
lines.zh: 你一个音都没错。一个都没有。

lines.en: I missed half a note in the middle.
lines.zh: 中间错了半个音。

lines.en: Nobody noticed. Half a note doesn't count.
lines.zh: 没人发现。半个音不算。

lines.en: Okay, but now the real question: what do you play NEXT year?
lines.zh: 好，但真正的问题是：明年你弹什么？

lines.en: Next year... I have an idea. But I'll need a singer.
lines.zh: 明年……我有个想法。但我需要一个歌手。

lines.en: Leo, neither of us can sing.
lines.zh: Leo，我们俩都不会唱歌。

lines.en: Jake. That was not a no.
lines.zh: Jake。那可不算拒绝。

lines.en: Before we slow things down — how to talk someone off (and onto) a stage.
lines.zh: 放慢之前——怎么把人从台上劝下来（以及劝上去）。

lines.en: It's a small thing, no big deal.
lines.zh: 小事一桩，没什么大不了。

lines.en: Tell us, or we find out on stage.
lines.zh: 快说，不然我们就在台下知道了。

lines.en: Nobody noticed.
lines.zh: 没人发现。

lines.en: That was not a no.
lines.zh: 那可不算拒绝。

lines.en: Did you know? Did HE know?
lines.zh: 你知道吗？他自己知道吗？

lines.en: and I quote
lines.zh: 原话是

lines.en: lose their minds
lines.zh: 疯狂／激动坏了

lines.en: If I mess up, no one mentions it.
lines.zh: 我搞砸了谁也不许提。

lines.en: Deal.
lines.zh: 成交。

lines.en: My hands are still shaking.
lines.zh: 我的手还在抖。

lines.en: Half a note doesn't count.
lines.zh: 半个音不算数。

lines.en: That was not a no.
lines.zh: 那可不算拒绝。

lines.en: Bravery challenge: name one thing you're a little scared to try, in English — and one tiny step you'll take this week. Say it out loud.
lines.zh: 勇气挑战：用英语说出一件你有点不敢尝试的事——以及这周你会迈出的一小步。大声说。

lines.en: Next time: winter holiday, forty dumplings from Grandma, and a family tradition of losing at video games. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 下一集：寒假、奶奶的四十个饺子，和一个全家打游戏必输的传统。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 春节与寒假
episodes.desc: 四十个饺子、捏脸的姨妈和侧着拿手机的奶奶

lines.en: Guess what Grandma sent us. Go on. Guess.
lines.zh: 猜猜奶奶给我们寄了什么。来，猜。

lines.en: Tea eggs?
lines.zh: 茶叶蛋？

lines.en: Better. A box of dumplings. Forty of them. Frozen. And a note: 'for the new year — eat well, sleep early, call me.'
lines.zh: 更好。一盒饺子。四十个。速冻的。还附了张字条：“新年好——吃饱、早睡、给我打电话。”

lines.en: Winter holiday: the smell of dumplings, relatives who think you grew ten centimeters, and zero alarms for two whole weeks.
lines.zh: 寒假：饺子的香味、觉得你长了十厘米的亲戚，和整整两周不用定闹钟的日子。

lines.en: Your grandma is the best person in this city.
lines.zh: 你奶奶是全市最好的人。

lines.en: She really is. So — plans for the holiday? My family's doing the usual: big dinner on New Year's Eve, then visiting relatives for three days.
lines.zh: 真的是。那——寒假有什么计划？我家照旧：除夕夜大餐，然后走亲戚三天。

lines.en: Ah yes. The three days of 'you've grown so tall' and 'are you eating enough?'
lines.zh: 啊对。那三天：“你长这么高了”“你吃够了吗”。

lines.en: Every. Single. Year. My aunt pinches my cheek. I'm fourteen.
lines.zh: 每。一。年。我姨妈都要捏我的脸。我都十四了。

lines.en: Embrace it. My family lives far away, so we video call instead. My grandma holds the phone sideways the entire time.
lines.zh: 接受吧。我家离得远，所以只能视频。我奶奶全程把手机横着拿。

lines.en: All grandmas do that.
lines.zh: 所有奶奶都那样。

lines.en: It's universal. But at least I get to see my cousins on screen. We play games together online at midnight.
lines.zh: 这是世界通用的。但至少能在屏幕上见到表弟表妹。我们半夜一起联网打游戏。

lines.en: That actually sounds fun. What games?
lines.zh: 这听起来确实挺好玩的。什么游戏？

lines.en: Mostly we lose at them. It's a tradition.
lines.zh: 主要是我们一直输。这是传统。

lines.en: You know what? This year I'm learning to make dumplings. Grandma says mine look like sad little clouds.
lines.zh: 你知道吗？今年我要学包饺子。奶奶说我包的像伤心的小云朵。

lines.en: Everyone's first dumplings look like sad little clouds. That's how you know they're homemade.
lines.zh: 所有人的第一个饺子都像伤心的小云朵。这正是 homemade 的证明。

lines.en: Before we slow things down — the vocabulary of family holidays.
lines.zh: 放慢之前——家庭假日的词汇表。

lines.en: Guess what Grandma sent us.
lines.zh: 猜猜奶奶给我们寄了什么。

lines.en: Big dinner on New Year's Eve.
lines.zh: 除夕夜吃大餐。

lines.en: We video call instead.
lines.zh: 我们改用视频通话。

lines.en: It's a tradition.
lines.zh: 这是个传统。

lines.en: Guess what!
lines.zh: 你猜怎么着！

lines.en: the usual
lines.zh: 照例／老一套

lines.en: Every. Single. Year.
lines.zh: 每。一。年。（强调每次都这样）

lines.en: Embrace it.
lines.zh: 接受它吧。

lines.en: It's universal.
lines.zh: 这是世界通用的。

lines.en: That actually sounds fun.
lines.zh: 这听起来确实好玩。

lines.en: It's a tradition.
lines.zh: 这是个传统。

lines.en: homemade
lines.zh: 自家做的（含温情）

lines.en: Holiday challenge: describe one family tradition in English — what you do, when, and why you keep doing it. One minute, out loud.
lines.zh: 节日挑战：用英语描述一个家庭传统——做什么、什么时候做、为什么一直做。一分钟，大声说。

lines.en: Next time: seventeen photos of a thumb, a very patient grandson, and the birth of Tech Grandma. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 下一集：十七张大拇指照片、一位非常有耐心的孙子，和“科技奶奶”的诞生。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 科技奶奶
episodes.desc: 手机课、绿色按钮和市场里的传奇

lines.en: Grandma, you don't need to press it hard. It's not a doorbell. It's a screen. Just tap it.
lines.zh: 奶奶，不用使劲按。它不是门铃。是屏幕。轻轻点一下就行。

lines.en: I AM tapping it. See? Tap, tap. Nothing happens.
lines.zh: 我就是在点啊。看？点，点。没反应。

lines.en: You're tapping the... that's the camera. You just took seventeen photos of your thumb.
lines.zh: 您点的是……那是相机。您刚给大拇指拍了十七张照片。

lines.en: Someone in your family taught you how to walk. One day, you get to teach them something back. Today: that day.
lines.zh: 家里有人教过你走路。总有一天，你可以教回他们一样东西。今天：就是那天。

lines.en: Okay, let's slow down. What do you want the phone to do?
lines.zh: 好，我们慢慢来。您想让手机做什么？

lines.en: Three things. Video call your mother. Watch my shows. And pay at the market, so I stop carrying cash.
lines.zh: 三件事。跟你妈视频。看我的剧。还有在市场付款，这样我就不用带现金了。

lines.en: Good news: all three are on this home screen. We just need to make the buttons bigger.
lines.zh: 好消息：三样都在这个主屏上。我们只需要把按钮变大。

lines.en: Bigger? There's a setting for that?
lines.zh: 变大？这还有设置？

lines.en: There's a setting for everything. Watch — settings, display, text size... see? Now everything's huge.
lines.zh: 什么都有设置。看——设置、显示、字体大小……看到没？现在全都变大了。

lines.en: Oh, THAT's better. Why do they make everything so small by default? Not everyone is twelve, you know.
lines.zh: 哦，这样好多了。他们为什么默认把一切做得这么小？可不是人人都十二岁。

lines.en: You should file a complaint. Grandma, one more thing — I'm setting up a shortcut. This green button is Mom. One press, video call, done.
lines.zh: 您该去投诉。奶奶，还有一件事——我给您设一个快捷方式。这个绿色按钮就是妈。一按，视频通话，搞定。

lines.en: One press? No menus?
lines.zh: 按一下？不用进菜单？

lines.en: No menus. Try it.
lines.zh: 不用菜单。您试试。

lines.en: Oh! It's ringing! Hi, dear! Look — I did it myself! No, HE didn't help, I did it MYSELF!
lines.zh: 哦！响了！喂，闺女！看——我自己弄的！不是，他没帮，是我自己弄的！

lines.en: She's telling on me. I did all of it. And she's telling everyone she did all of it.
lines.zh: 她在“举报”我。全都是我弄的。而她跟所有人说是她自己弄的。

lines.en: Teamwork, sweetheart. But mostly me.
lines.zh: 团队合作，好孩子。但主要是我。

lines.en: One week later, Leo checks in. And Grandma has news of her own.
lines.zh: 一周后，Leo 回访。奶奶也有自己的新闻。

lines.en: So, how's the phone this week, Grandma?
lines.zh: 那，这周手机用得怎么样，奶奶？

lines.en: Wonderful. I watched two shows, called your mother nine times, and I paid at the market like a queen. The young man at the fish stall calls me 'Tech Grandma.'
lines.zh: 好极了。我看了两部剧，给你妈打了九次电话，还在市场像个女王一样付款。鱼摊的小伙子叫我“科技奶奶”。

lines.en: Tech Grandma. That's it. That's your official name now.
lines.zh: 科技奶奶。就这样。这是您的官方称号了。

lines.en: I accept. Now — next lesson: those short videos. Your cousin sends them and I want to send some back.
lines.zh: 我接受。现在——下一课：那些小视频。你表妹老发给我，我想回发一些。

lines.en: Grandma, you're going to be more online than I am.
lines.zh: 奶奶，你会比我泡网上还久。

lines.en: Good. Then I can comment on your posts.
lines.zh: 很好。那我就能去你帖子底下评论了。

lines.en: ...I've made a mistake.
lines.zh: ……我犯了个错误。

lines.en: Before we slow down — how to teach anything to anyone, in English.
lines.zh: 放慢之前——怎么用英语把任何东西教给任何人。

lines.en: You don't need to press it hard.
lines.zh: 不用使劲按。

lines.en: Just tap it.
lines.zh: 轻轻点一下就行。

lines.en: There's a setting for that.
lines.zh: 这有设置可以改。

lines.en: Try it.
lines.zh: 试试看。

lines.en: It's not a doorbell. It's a screen.
lines.zh: 它不是门铃，是屏幕。

lines.en: Just tap it.
lines.zh: 轻轻点一下。

lines.en: Let's slow down.
lines.zh: 我们慢慢来。

lines.en: There's a setting for everything.
lines.zh: 什么都有设置。

lines.en: One press, done.
lines.zh: 一按，搞定。

lines.en: I did it myself!
lines.zh: 我自己做到的！

lines.en: She's telling on me.
lines.zh: 她在“举报”我（告状）。

lines.en: I've made a mistake.
lines.zh: 我犯了个错误（幽默）。

lines.en: Teaching challenge: pick one thing you're good at — a game, a dish, a phone trick — and explain step one in English, out loud, in thirty seconds.
lines.zh: 教学挑战：挑一样你擅长的事——游戏、菜、手机技巧——用英语讲出第一步，三十秒，大声说。

lines.en: Next time: ketchup on ice cream, a seventy-two on a quiz, and the world's most annoying supportive friend. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 下一集：冰淇淋上的番茄酱、七十二分的测验，和全世界最烦人但也最暖心的朋友。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 糟糕的一天
episodes.desc: 碎了的眼镜、掉了的餐盘和一句“你是对的，但你很烦”

lines.en: Hey. You okay? You've been quiet all day.
lines.zh: 嘿。还好吗？你一整天都没怎么说话。

lines.en: I'm fine.
lines.zh: 我没事。

lines.en: Mia. You just put ketchup on your ice cream.
lines.zh: Mia。你刚刚往冰淇淋上挤了番茄酱。

lines.en: Some days are just... days. Everything goes wrong, all at once, on purpose. Today's episode: the bad day, and how friends help.
lines.zh: 有些日子就……是那种日子。所有事一起出错，像是故意的。今天的节目：糟糕的一天，以及朋友怎么帮忙。

lines.en: ...I need to tell you about my day.
lines.zh: ……我得跟你讲讲我今天怎么了。

lines.en: Go ahead. I have snacks and nowhere to be.
lines.zh: 说吧。我有零食，也没地方要去。

lines.en: So. This morning I broke my glasses. Then I got gum in my hair in second class. Then at lunch I dropped my tray. In front of EVERYONE.
lines.zh: 就这样。早上我眼镜摔了。然后第二节课头发上粘了口香糖。午饭时我把餐盘打翻了。当着所有人的面。

lines.en: Oh no.
lines.zh: 天哪。

lines.en: And the worst part? I studied all week for the math quiz, and I still got a seventy-two.
lines.zh: 最糟的是什么？数学小测我复习了一整周，结果还是只考了七十二。

lines.en: Okay. First: give me the ice cream before you put anything else on it.
lines.zh: 好。第一：趁你还没往上加别的东西，把冰淇淋给我。

lines.en: Thanks.
lines.zh: 谢了。

lines.en: Second: one bad day is not a bad week. And a seventy-two on one quiz doesn't erase a week of studying. It just means the quiz was rude.
lines.zh: 第二：糟糕的一天不是糟糕的一周。一次小测的七十二分也抹不掉你一整周的复习。它只能说明这份卷子很没礼貌。

lines.en: That's not how math works, Jake.
lines.zh: 数学不是这么算的，Jake。

lines.en: It's how FRIENDS work. Look — tomorrow's a new day. New day, new tray, no gum.
lines.zh: 朋友就是这么算的。看——明天是新的一天。新的一天、新餐盘、没有口香糖。

lines.en: You know what's annoying? You're right, and you're annoying about it.
lines.zh: 你知道最气人的是什么吗？你是对的，而且你对得让人很烦。

lines.en: I've been told. Come on, let's go shoot some hoops. Losing at basketball will make you feel better about the quiz.
lines.zh: 很多人这么说。走，去投两个球。在篮球上输一场，你就会对小测感觉好一点。

lines.en: You mean YOU'LL lose.
lines.zh: 你是说“你”会输吧。

lines.en: We'll see who loses, ketchup girl.
lines.zh: 看看谁输，番茄酱女士。

lines.en: Before we slow things down — the language of cheering someone up.
lines.zh: 放慢之前——哄人开心的语言。

lines.en: You've been quiet all day.
lines.zh: 你一整天都没怎么说话。

lines.en: I need to tell you about my day.
lines.zh: 我得跟你讲讲我今天怎么了。

lines.en: Tomorrow's a new day.
lines.zh: 明天是新的一天。

lines.en: Let's go shoot some hoops.
lines.zh: 走，去投两个球。

lines.en: You've been quiet all day.
lines.zh: 你一整天都很安静。

lines.en: Go ahead.
lines.zh: 说吧／去吧。

lines.en: One bad day is not a bad week.
lines.zh: 糟糕的一天不是糟糕的一周。

lines.en: That's not how ... works.
lines.zh: ……不是这么回事的。

lines.en: You're right, and you're annoying about it.
lines.zh: 你是对的，但对得让人烦。

lines.en: I've been told.
lines.zh: 很多人这么说（自嘲）。

lines.en: In front of everyone
lines.zh: 当着所有人的面

lines.en: We'll see.
lines.zh: 走着瞧。

lines.en: Kindness challenge: think of a friend who had a hard day. Say one encouraging sentence to them in English — out loud, so it's ready when you need it.
lines.zh: 善意挑战：想一个今天过得不好的朋友。用英语对他说一句鼓励的话——大声说出来，等需要的时候就能脱口而出。

lines.en: Next time: a career survey, a cat burgling a museum, and the most normal answer in the world. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 下一集：一份职业调查、一只偷博物馆的猫，和世界上最正常的答案。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 长大想做什么
episodes.desc: 游戏设计师、未来的兽医和还没说出口的梦想

lines.en: Career survey for school. Question one: what do you want to be? And 'rich' is not an answer.
lines.zh: 学校的职业调查。第一题：你想成为什么？“有钱”不算答案。

lines.en: You just took away my only answer.
lines.zh: 你刚刚剥夺了我唯一的答案。

lines.en: Leo. Real answer. Now.
lines.zh: Leo。真答案。快。

lines.en: What do you want to be when you grow up? The most famous question in school — and the most unfair one, if you ask me.
lines.zh: 你长大想做什么？学校里最有名的问题——依我说，也是最不公平的一个。

lines.en: Okay, fine. Real answer: game designer. I have a notebook full of game ideas. Level designs, characters, everything.
lines.zh: 好吧，行。真答案：游戏设计师。我有个本子全是游戏点子。关卡设计、角色，什么都有。

lines.en: Seriously? Can I see?
lines.zh: 真的假的？我能看看吗？

lines.en: Sure. This one's a puzzle game where you're a cat burgling a museum.
lines.zh: 当然。这个是解谜游戏，你扮演一只偷博物馆的猫。

lines.en: A cat. Burgling. Leo, this is actually good. The levels make sense and everything.
lines.zh: 一只猫。在偷东西。Leo，这真的挺好。关卡逻辑都通。

lines.en: I've been working on it since fifth grade. What about you?
lines.zh: 我从五年级就开始弄了。你呢？

lines.en: I don't know yet. Everyone else has answers. Emma wants to be a vet, you want to make games, Mia wants—
lines.zh: 我还不知道。别人都有答案。Emma 想当兽医，你想做游戏，Mia 想——

lines.en: Mia wants to build robots. She just doesn't say it out loud yet.
lines.zh: Mia 想造机器人。她只是还没大声说出来。

lines.en: Wait, really? How do you know?
lines.zh: 等等，真的吗？你怎么知道的？

lines.en: She checks out every robot book in the library. Twice. And she 'fixes' things at home for fun. Jake, some people just need time.
lines.zh: 她把图书馆所有机器人书都借遍了。每本借了两次。她在家还“修”东西玩。Jake，有些人只是需要时间。

lines.en: That's... actually comforting. So it's okay to not know yet?
lines.zh: 这……真让人安心。所以还不知道也没关系？

lines.en: It's the most normal thing in the world. You're fourteen. You have, like, a million days to figure it out.
lines.zh: 这是世界上最正常的事。你才十四岁。你有差不多一百万天去想明白。

lines.en: A million days. Okay. I can work with that.
lines.zh: 一百万天。行。这个说法我能接受。

lines.en: Before we slow down — the language of big, not-yet-decided dreams.
lines.zh: 放慢之前——用来谈论“还没想好”的大梦想的语言。

lines.en: What do you want to be?
lines.zh: 你想成为什么？

lines.en: I don't know yet.
lines.zh: 我还不知道。

lines.en: I've been working on it since fifth grade.
lines.zh: 我从五年级就开始做了。

lines.en: Some people just need time.
lines.zh: 有些人只是需要时间。

lines.en: What do you want to be?
lines.zh: 你长大想做什么？

lines.en: 'Rich' is not an answer.
lines.zh: “有钱”不算答案。

lines.en: Real answer.
lines.zh: 真答案。

lines.en: Can I see?
lines.zh: 我能看看吗？

lines.en: I don't know yet.
lines.zh: 我还不知道。

lines.en: How do you know?
lines.zh: 你怎么知道的？

lines.en: Some people just need time.
lines.zh: 有些人只是需要时间。

lines.en: I can work with that.
lines.zh: 这个说法我能接受。

lines.en: Dream challenge: in English, describe one job that sounds interesting to you — what they do all day, and one skill you'd need. You don't have to be sure. Out loud.
lines.zh: 梦想挑战：用英语描述一份你觉得有意思的职业——他们每天做什么，需要什么技能。不用确定。大声说。

lines.en: Next time: exam week. Color-coded schedules, imaginary students, and the most important study tip of all. See you on the next walk!
lines.zh: 下一集：考试周。彩色时间表、想象中的学生，和最重要的一条学习建议。下次散步见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。

episodes.title: 考试周
episodes.desc: 彩色的时间表、睡前的物理公式和一场迟到的骑行

lines.en: It's here. Exam week. I dreamt about math formulas last night. In COLOR.
lines.zh: 来了。考试周。我昨晚梦见数学公式了。还是彩色的。

lines.en: Mia, you need sleep more than you need another hour of formulas.
lines.zh: Mia，比起再多刷一小时公式，你更需要睡觉。

lines.en: Don't distract me with logic. I'm memorizing.
lines.zh: 别用逻辑干扰我。我在背书。

lines.en: Exam week. The week when everyone suddenly discovers the library. Today: study tricks that actually work — and one very important rule about sleep.
lines.zh: 考试周。所有人突然发现图书馆的那一周。今天：真正有用的学习方法——和一条关于睡眠的非常重要的规则。

lines.en: Okay, real talk. How's the studying going?
lines.zh: 好，说实话。复习得怎么样？

lines.en: I made a schedule. Color-coded. Then I broke the schedule. Then I made a new schedule to feel better about breaking the old one.
lines.zh: 我做了个时间表。带颜色标注的。然后我打破了它。然后为了对打破旧表感觉好点，我又做了个新的。

lines.en: That's the most Mia thing I've ever heard. What's actually hard?
lines.zh: 这是我听过最有 Mia 味的话。到底哪科难？

lines.en: Physics formulas. They all look the same. V equals this, P equals that... my brain just gives up.
lines.zh: 物理公式。长得全都一样。V 等于这个，P 等于那个……我的大脑直接放弃。

lines.en: My trick: I explain it out loud to an imaginary student. If I can teach it, I know it. Want to try? Teach me one formula right now.
lines.zh: 我的诀窍：大声讲给一个想象中的学生听。能教会别人，就说明自己会了。试试？现在教我一条公式。

lines.en: Okay... distance equals speed times time. So if a bus goes sixty kilometers an hour for two hours...
lines.zh: 好……距离等于速度乘时间。那如果一辆公交车以每小时六十公里开了两个小时……

lines.en: ...One hundred twenty kilometers. See? You know it.
lines.zh: ……一百二十公里。看？你会了。

lines.en: Huh. Saying it out loud actually helps. Why does that work?
lines.zh: 咦。说出来真的有用。这是什么原理？

lines.en: No idea. It just does. Also: tonight, close the books by ten and sleep.
lines.zh: 不知道。反正就是有用。还有：今晚十点前合上书，去睡觉。

lines.en: But I haven't finished—
lines.zh: 可我还没复习完——

lines.en: A tired brain forgets more than a rested brain learns. Sleep IS studying. Doctor's orders.
lines.zh: 疲劳的大脑忘掉的，比休息好的大脑学到的还多。睡觉就是复习。医嘱。

lines.en: You're not a doctor.
lines.zh: 你又不是医生。

lines.en: Future doctor. Manifesting.
lines.zh: 未来的医生。先说先赢。

lines.en: And then — the exams end. There is always a moment after exam week that tastes like freedom. Here it is.
lines.zh: 然后——考试结束。考试周之后总有一个瞬间，尝起来像自由。就是现在。

lines.en: It's OVER. Done. Finished. I'm free!
lines.zh: 结束了！完成！结束！我自由了！

lines.en: How do you think it went?
lines.zh: 你觉得考得怎么样？

lines.en: Math was fair, physics was mean, English was easy. Classic.
lines.zh: 数学还行，物理很坏，英语简单。经典组合。

lines.en: Same. Now — two months of freedom. Bike trip? The one the rain ruined?
lines.zh: 一样。现在——两个月自由时光。骑行去？上次被雨毁掉的那个？

lines.en: The one the rain ruined. Saturday, nine sharp.
lines.zh: 被雨毁掉的那个。周六，九点整。

lines.en: Nine fifteen.
lines.zh: 九点十五。

lines.en: ...You checked the tickets, didn't you.
lines.zh: ……你查过车票了，是不是。

lines.en: I made a folder.
lines.zh: 我做了个文件夹。

lines.en: Before we slow down — the exam week survival kit, in four sentences.
lines.zh: 放慢之前——考试周生存包，四句话搞定。

lines.en: How's the studying going?
lines.zh: 复习得怎么样？

lines.en: Distance equals speed times time.
lines.zh: 距离等于速度乘时间。

lines.en: Saying it out loud actually helps.
lines.zh: 说出来真的有用。

lines.en: Sleep IS studying.
lines.zh: 睡觉就是复习。

lines.en: Real talk.
lines.zh: 说实话吧。

lines.en: Color-coded
lines.zh: 用颜色标注的

lines.en: My brain just gives up.
lines.zh: 我的大脑直接放弃。

lines.en: If I can teach it, I know it.
lines.zh: 能教别人，就说明自己会了。

lines.en: Saying it out loud actually helps.
lines.zh: 大声说出来真的有用。

lines.en: No idea. It just does.
lines.zh: 不知道原理。反正有用。

lines.en: A tired brain forgets more.
lines.zh: 疲劳的大脑忘得更多。

lines.en: Nine sharp.
lines.zh: 九点整。

lines.en: Tonight, teach one thing you learned today to your imaginary student — out loud, in English, for one minute. If you can teach it, you know it.
lines.zh: 今晚，把今天学到的一样东西讲给你想象中的学生听——用英语、出声、一分钟。能教别人，就是真的会了。

lines.en: That's the end of season one — twenty walks, twenty conversations. Replay your favorites, practice your lines, and I'll see you on the next walk. Bye for now!
lines.zh: 第一季到此结束——二十次散步、二十段对话。重听你喜欢的集数，练熟你的台词，我们下次散步见。再见！

lines.en: All right — one more time, slower. Listen and repeat after me.
lines.zh: 好——再放一遍，这次更慢。听着，跟着一起说。
